description: Set the feature values a CSV, TSV, JSON or JSON Lines file assigns, one row per element (the ImportData RPC, the CLI's -import with -import-as, -import-map, -import-format and -import-dry-run): a feature the element declares has its value set, one it inherits is redefined in the element's body with the value, as one edit per file; a value the model refuses leaves every row unapplied and answers `error`. `files` carry each assignment with the element, feature, value and the inherited feature it redefines; the edited text comes back as `content` (one document) or `documents` with the `modelHash` of the imported model, nothing is written to disk. A dry run answers the assignments alone. The result is the ImportDataResponse as protojson writes it.

acceptDocuments.description: accept every edited document in documents when the model has several

importAs.description: what each row is made into (the CLI's -import-as): values, the default, sets the features of the element the row names

importDryRun.description: report the values the imports would set, changing nothing (the CLI's -import-dry-run)

imports.description: the data files, applied in order as one edit each

content.description: the file's text: one row per element, an element column naming the element and each other column a feature, as 'mass [kg]'

importFormat.description: read the content as csv, tsv, json or jsonl rather than as the name's extension says (the CLI's -import-format)

importMap.description: the JSON mapping onto elements and features the content is read by (the CLI's -import-map file); empty for the content's own header

name.description: the file's name, which names its format by extension (csv, tsv, json, jsonl) and the file in what goes wrong

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

name: import_data
